Across different roles and stages of the creative pipeline, TourBox becomes part of the workflow, helping artists stay focused on creating while handling the small controls that add up throughout the process.

#TourBox #Animation #DigitalArtist

Hand crafting a stop motion mixed media animation ✂️🌸📸 @adobecreativecloud #adobepartner 

Here’s the full breakdown of how I made this animation! I’ve been wanting to use my hands again to make something irl and I legit spent too many hours to count just cutting out these little flowers and the cutouts of myself. But really happy with how it turned out! Shoutout to Adobe tools for helping me bring it all together

content.body:
Day 155/365 of helping Creators.

This effect is called the Grungy Transition, a great way to improve your product shots.

• How do you take a boring product shot and make it look like you spent double the budget?
Special thanks to @adobecreativecloud for partnering up with me today to make this video happen
Here’s my exact process:
✦ Start with a basic color graded cut
✦ Pull a grunge transition from the Adobe Stock panel in Adobe Premiere and drop it over the sequence
✦ Use the Object Mask tool to wrap an animation around the product
✦ Layer in a glitchy sound effect and a whoosh to match the vibe
✦ Search for music filtered by mood and genre without leaving the timeline
✦ Finish with a title that matches the aesthetic The whole thing without switching tabs, without downloading from third party sites, without breaking the creative flow.
Try the Adobe Stock panel in Premiere and level up your product shots without touching your pre-production budget. #adobestock #adobe #videoediting #filmmaking #adobepartner

✨ @le.petitchef at @radissonblubucharest ✨

🍽️ The concept: A unique dining experience where the smallest animated chef appears on your table and takes you on a culinary journey through a playful 3D projection, perfectly combining storytelling, animation and food.

📅 When: Thursday – Sunday

🕖 Thursday & Friday: 7 PM
🕔 Saturday & Sunday: 5 PM & 8 PM

🍴 Menus:
✨ Classic Menu
🌱 Vegetarian Menu
👧 Kids’ Menu

🎥 Each course comes to life through the projection on your table, with the little chef “preparing” your meal before the real dish arrives. 

It’s more than just dinner!  It’s a fun, immersive experience for both adults and kids.

📍 Radisson Blu Hotel, Bucharest

#ad #immersivedining #bucharestexperience #lepetitchef #foodie

Imagine sitting down for dinner… and before your food even arrives, four tiny chefs appear on your table and start preparing it right in front of you 👨‍🍳✨

At @le.petitchef at @andazprague , dining turns into a full-on show 🎭 Through 3D animation, your table becomes a stage where every course is introduced by these little chefs, taking you on a journey around the world 🌍

We chose the ‘Le Petit Chef & Friends Classic’ menu, which brings together four dishes inspired by different countries 🍽️

We started in Spain 🇪🇸 with Iberico jamón, heritage tomatoes, manchego, and salsa verde 🌿

Then we moved to Italy 🇮🇹 with ricotta ravioli, wild mushrooms, crispy parmesan, speck, and truffle cream 🤍

Next was France 🇫🇷: a perfectly cooked beef fillet with potato dauphinoise, baby carrots, and béarnaise sauce 🥩

And to finish, Japan 🇯🇵 — a delicate matcha Mont Blanc with matcha meringue and joconde biscuit 🍵

What makes this experience so special is how every dish is connected to the story unfolding on your table 🎬 It’s not just about eating — it’s about watching, feeling, and experiencing every course before it even arrives ✨

It’s creative, immersive, and honestly one of the most unique dinners you can have in Prague 💫

#invited #lepetitechef #lepetitechefprague #andazhotel #wheretoeatinprague

A different kind of dining experience with animation chefs leading the menu 👩‍🍳

🍴 @le.petitchef
